supersedes.status: historical, preserved byte-identical for audit at its original paths and source commits and never rewritten. It is superseded because its cpython-3.14.5 interpreter artifact is unavailable in the present development closure, not because it was wrong.

reason: Every M1d normalization derivation binds derivation.python_identity at patch granularity. The development interpreter moved from CPython 3.14.5 to 3.14.6, and the cpython-3.14.5 interpreter artifact is not available in the present development closure, whose interpreter is Homebrew CPython 3.14.6. Issue 47 established that python_identity is the only independent input that differs: lockfile_hash, implementation_hash, semantic_algorithm_hash and output_hash are identical. Per the architecture ruling on issue 47, the replay environment is pinned forward to exactly cpython-3.14.6 in .python-version, patch-level identity is kept, and a new baseline is minted from the same source commits that generated the historical one.

reconstruction: For each generation the replay archive is git archive of source_commit, authenticated against the preserved v3 inventory, with exactly the superseded_paths replaced. Each replaced path must first hold its historical_sha256; fixture paths then take the bytes at baseline_path, and the archived loader takes its historical bytes with the one hash-index.json digest literal swapped. Every result must hash to current_sha256. No path under src/ can be superseded. Enforced at load and at replay time by tests/_pinned_m1d.py.

verification.regenerated_on: macos arm64, Homebrew CPython 3.14.6; the platform is not part of M1d replay identity
verification.method: Each generation was regenerated by its own source commit's generator (write_fixture_v1, write_fixture_v2, write_fixture_v3) from a git archive of that commit under cpython-3.14.6. Of the 160 files in each generation exactly three differ from the historical baseline: the two expected result documents and hash-index.json.
verification.launder_check: In each result document the only differing leaves are derivation.python_identity (cpython-3.14.5 to cpython-3.14.6) and its pure digests derivation_hash, view.derivation_hash, reference.derivation_hash and reference.view_hash. Restoring cpython-3.14.5 and recomputing those digests reproduces the historical bytes exactly. hash-index.json differs only in the sha256 entries of the two result documents. lockfile_hash, implementation_hash, semantic_algorithm_hash and output_hash are unchanged.
verification.replay: Every archived M1d replay node, including each generation's own generator reproduction node, passes against this baseline under cpython-3.14.6.
